prompt: Viết mô tả chi tiết một bức chân dung ngoài trời của một phụ nữ trẻ đang cười rạng rỡ dưới ánh nắng chiều.
response: Golden-hour outdoor portrait of a young Vietnamese woman laughing, shot with an 85mm f/1.4 lens at eye level. Warm, low-angle sunlight rakes across her left cheek, creating a soft rim light in her wind-tossed hair, while her right side melts into gentle shadow. Her eyes are fully crinkled with genuine joy, dimples visible, lips parted mid-laugh. Detailed skin texture with fine pores and subtle freckles, no heavy retouching. Background is a bokeh-blurred rice field with sun flare creeping over the horizon. Composition follows the rule of thirds, subject slightly off-center, generous headroom. Mood: radiant, carefree, cinematic. Style: authentic film look, high-fidelity details, natural color grading with warm tones.

prompt: Tả chi tiết chân dung một cụ ông ngồi trên bậc thềm, khuôn mặt khắc khổ nhiều nếp nhăn.
response: Tight portrait of an elderly Vietnamese man seated on a mossy stone doorstep, photographed with a 50mm lens at f/2.8. His weathered face is a map of deep wrinkles — crow's feet fanning from narrowed eyes, furrowed brow lines, and sun-darkened leathery skin with visible age spots and a trimmed white beard. He wears a traditional beige nón lá tilted forward, casting a soft triangular shadow over half his face. Morning light from the left rakes across the texture of his skin, highlighting every crease. He looks straight into the camera with quiet, piercing dignity. Background: blurred courtyard with a banyan tree and drying laundry. Color grade leans earthy sepia and muted green. Mood: contemplative, resilient, timeless. Authentic documentary style, high-fidelity texture detail.

prompt: Viết mô tả chân dung cận cảnh một cậu bé đang ngơ ngác nhìn mưa qua cửa kính.
response: Close-up portrait of a young boy pressed against a rain-streaked window, shot with a 35mm lens at close distance. His wide, curious eyes reflect the grey daylight through the glass, brows slightly raised in innocent wonder. prompt: Mô tả bức chân dung studio của một người đàn ông trung niên với ánh sáng Rembrandt.
response: Studio portrait of a middle-aged man in a charcoal suit, lit in classic Rembrandt style. A single key light at 45 degrees carves a small, triangular patch of light onto his right cheek, while the left side of his face falls into rich shadow. Deep black backdrop isolates the subject. A soft fill light gently lifts the shadow side to reveal subtle skin pores without flattening the drama. Posture is relaxed but upright, one hand in pocket. Style: editorial photography, high-fidelity skin detail, neutral graded tones. Mood: confident, composed, timeless.

prompt: Viết mô tả ảnh chụp cận mặt một cô gái đang nhắm mắt tận hưởng gió biển, tóc bay.
response: Close-up beauty portrait of a young woman with eyes closed, chin tilted up to meet a warm sea breeze, shot with an 85mm f/2 lens. prompt: Tả chân dung một người mẹ đang ôm con, biểu cảm dịu dàng trong ánh hoàng hôn.
response: Heartwarming portrait of a young mother cradling her sleeping toddler against her chest, photographed during the last glow of sunset. Her eyes are cast downward at the baby with a tender, half-smiling expression; one hand supports the child's head, the other strokes its back. Warm amber light rakes horizontally across both figures, rim-lighting the curve of her shoulder and the baby's chubby cheek. The setting is a quiet village alley with drying flowers and soft dust motes floating in the light. Skin rendered with gentle texture, no blemish retouching, a few stray hairs glowing. Shot on a 50mm at f/2.5, shallow depth of field blurs the background into a dreamy golden wash. Style: candid family documentary, warm cinematic grade. Mood: loving, calm, protective.

prompt: Mô tả chi tiết khuôn mặt và biểu cảm của một thanh niên đang tập trung lắng nghe nhạc bằng tai nghe.
response: Medium close-up of a young man with over-ear headphones, lost in music, shot with a 50mm lens under a single warm desk lamp. prompt: Viết mô tả chân dung đôi bạn trẻ đang cười đùa trong công viên, ánh nắng xuyên qua lá.

prompt: Mô tả bức chân dung một người phụ nữ lớn tuổi đang khâu vá bên hiên nhà, ánh sáng buổi sớm.
